import json
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[3]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "domains" / "mount"))

from model import load_payload
from transform import transform


class TestMountParse(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_basic_records(self):
        contract = {"name": "mount", "operation": "mount_parse", "inputs": ["x"], "output": "y"}
        payload = {"mount": "/dev/live on /data type ext4 (rw,relatime)\ntmpfs on /tmp47 type tmpfs (rw)\n"}
        result = transform([payload], contract)
        self.assertEqual(set(result), {"name", "result"})
        self.assertEqual(result["name"], "mount")
        records = result["result"]["records"]
        self.assertEqual(len(records), 2)
        self.assertEqual(records[0]["device"], "/dev/live")
        self.assertEqual(records[0]["mount"], "/data")
        self.assertEqual(records[0]["fstype"], "ext4")
        self.assertEqual(records[0]["options"], ["relatime", "rw"])
        self.assertEqual(records[1]["device"], "tmpfs")
        self.assertEqual(records[1]["mount"], "/tmp47")
        self.assertEqual(records[1]["fstype"], "tmpfs")
        self.assertEqual(records[1]["options"], ["rw"])

    def test_escape_and_dedup(self):
        contract = {"name": "mount", "operation": "mount_parse", "inputs": ["x"], "output": "y"}
        payload = {"mount": "/dev/x on /with\\040space type xfs (ro,ro)\n"}
        result = transform([payload], contract)
        records = result["result"]["records"]
        self.assertEqual(records[0]["mount"], "/with space")
        self.assertEqual(records[0]["options"], ["ro"])

    def test_empty_options_invalid(self):
        contract = {"name": "mount", "operation": "mount_parse", "inputs": ["x"], "output": "y"}
        payload = {"mount": "/dev/x on /m type xfs ()\n"}
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            transform([payload], contract)

    def test_bad_line_invalid(self):
        contract = {"name": "mount", "operation": "mount_parse", "inputs": ["x"], "output": "y"}
        payload = {"mount": "garbage line\n"}
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            transform([payload], contract)

    def test_load_payload_rejects_nan(self):
        import tempfile
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile("w", suffix=".json", delete=False) as f:
            f.write('{"a": NaN}')
            name = f.name
        try:
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                load_payload(name)
        finally:
            Path(name).unlink()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
